drhp.business: Bajaj Finance Limited is a deposit-taking NBFC-ICC (upper layer) engaged in lending, partnerships and services, payments, and deposit acceptance. It offers a diversified portfolio across retail, MSME, and commercial customers with deep presence in both urban and rural India. The company operates through an omnichannel model spanning 4,098 locations and 242,000 active distribution points, supported by its digital app and web platforms.
drhp.end_markets: India – urban and rural, including 2,571 rural/smaller town locations
drhp.expansion: Bajaj Finance continued to expand its physical distribution and product reach across multiple lending verticals during FY2026. In Gold Loans, 350 standalone branches were added, taking the standalone network to 1,314 branches and the overall gold loan branch network to 1,507 branches. The Microfinance group lending business scaled from a pilot to 11 states, covering 41,266 villages through 447 branches. sk.overview: India's digital financial services and NBFC-led retail lending sector serves a large, young, credit-underpenetrated mass market. Formalization (GST, JAM/India Stack, eKYC), rising smartphone/internet penetration and low data costs are enabling tech-led NBFCs and fintechs to underwrite and serve borrowers that conventional banks have historically underserved, particularly in unsecured personal loans and loan-against-property.
